name: io.github.datolabs-io/mcp-toolsearch-proxy
title: Tool Search Proxy
description: Lets a model search and call a large MCP tool catalog through five tools instead of loading it

environmentVariables.name: TOOLSEARCH_UPSTREAM
environmentVariables.description: Streamable HTTP URL of the MCP server whose tools are searched, such as a gateway

environmentVariables.name: TOOLSEARCH_EMBEDDER
environmentVariables.description: builtin for semantic search, which needs the model in a volume at /model (see docs/deploy.md); none for lexical search only
